notes: ⭐⭐ THE BEST SPRING FIND IN THIS SLICE FOR A TECHNICAL CANDIDATE. 60 ECTS in one year, ENGLISH-ONLY (removes the Spanish A0/A1 filter), official and renewed, cheap even at the explicitly published non-EU rate, and a genuine February cohort with its own 20-place quota rather than an application round. Path-C/A relevance: itineraris include 'Itineraris de l'àrea de multimèdia (ETSETB): Deep Learning for Multimedia Processing', plus signal/information-processing content ('Sistemes de tractament de la informació: codificació, compressió, correcció d'errors, reconeixement d'imatge, reconeixement de seqüències de vídeo'). NON-EU SURCHARGE CONFIRMED and quantified on the page itself — roughly 2.3x. Courses run in both quadrimestres so a February entrant can take the core; optatives are taught once a year only, at one centre, which constrains a February entrant's optional choices ('Les assignatures optatives s'imparteixen només a un centre i només un cop per any').
